meta.name: orca-cli
meta.description: Use the public `orca` CLI to operate Orca-managed worktrees, folder contexts, terminals, repos, automations, artifacts, skill sharing, worktree comments, and the browser embedded inside the Orca app. Use when the user says "$orca-cli", "use orca cli", "Orca worktree", "child worktree", "cardStatus", "spawn codex/claude in a worktree", "read/wait/send Orca terminal", "terminal send", "full handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree", "Orca browser", "orca artifacts", "share HTML/Markdown", "public artifact link", "share skills", or "control the browser inside Orca". Prefer this over raw `git worktree`, ad hoc PTYs, Playwright, or Computer Use when the task touches Orca-managed state. Use Computer Use for external browser windows, webviews, or desktop UI only when the task requires OS/window-level control such as focus, menus, dialogs, coordinates, or screenshots. Use `orca-cli` for Orca's embedded pages and a page-automation tool such as Playwright or CDP for external pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行操控Orca的代码、终端和AI助手
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在Orca里管理多个开发任务,想要用命令行统一控制
copy.tagline_en: Manage Orca's code workspaces, terminals, and AI agents via CLI.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Orca to manage multiple dev tasks and want CLI control.

howto.what: 装上这个技能后,当你提到 Orca 工作树、终端等资源时,Claude 会改用 Orca 自带的命令行工具来操作,而不是直接动普通文件。运行前它会先查一份与当前版本匹配的最新说明,再执行对应命令。
howto.when: 当你说出“$orca-cli”、“Orca worktree”或“full handoff”等短语,或要求操作 Orca 里的终端、内嵌浏览器时,技能会触发。

say.text: 用 orca-cli 创建一个 child worktree
say.note: 会调用 orca 命令新建一个工作树。

say.text: 把当前任务 full handoff 给另一个 agent
say.note: 会触发 orca-cli 的交接流程,移交任务状态。

say.text: 在 Orca 终端里发送这条命令
say.note: 会通过 orca-cli 把命令输入到指定终端。

howto.what_en: When the user mentions Orca worktrees, terminals, etc., Claude uses the `orca` CLI to operate them instead of plain shell/file tools. Before acting it loads the version-matched command guide, then runs the requested operation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says "$orca-cli", "Orca worktree", or "full handoff" (or similar phrases), or asks to operate an Orca terminal or its embedded browser.

say_en.text: Create a child worktree using orca-cli.
say_en.note: Runs the orca command to make a new worktree.

say_en.text: Give this task a full handoff to another agent.
say_en.note: Triggers orca-cli's handoff flow to transfer state.

say_en.text: Send this command in the Orca terminal.
say_en.note: Feeds the command to the target Orca terminal via orca-cli.
